# Red Eagle Group of Institutions

A premium school website built with React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and Sanity CMS.

## Core Pages
- Home: Overview of the school, hero section, facilities preview, and FAQ.
- About: Detailed history and mission of R.E.P.S.
- Facilities: Showcase of infrastructure, labs, and library.
- Events: Gallery of school events like Annual Function, Sports Day, etc.
- Toppers: Academic achievements and toppers showcase.
- Contact: Admission enquiry and campus location.

## Technology Stack
- Frontend: React 18, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Shadcn UI, Lucide Icons.
- CMS: Sanity.io for dynamic content management.
- SEO: Optimized with sitemap.xml, robots.txt, and structured data.

## Deployment Information
- Site URL: https://redeaglepublicschool.com/
- CMS Dashboard: Located in the /studio directory.
